name: Investment Plan
definition: Plan that allows investors to schedule periodical investments or divestments, according to pre-defined criteria.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Frequency of the investment or divestment, eg, daily, weekly, or monthly.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Currency and amount of the periodical payments. When the standing order is related to a fund investment plan, this is the cash part of the invested amount.

MultiCurrency.name: Multi Currency
MultiCurrency.definition: Specifies whether the investment plan is multi currency or not.

PlanStatus.name: Plan Status
PlanStatus.definition: Status of the savings or withdrawal investment plan.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Security that an investment plan invests in, or from which the investment plan divests.

Instalment.name: Instalment
Instalment.definition: Specifies information on the successive payments in an investment plan.

RelatedService.name: Related Service
RelatedService.definition: Service which provides a systematic investment plan.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Insurance contract which covers the investment plan.

StandingOrder.name: Standing Order
StandingOrder.definition: Order generated automatically, according to the terms of the investment plan.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Portfolio for which the investment plan invests or divests.

InvestmentPeriod.name: Investment Period
InvestmentPeriod.definition: Period during which an investment plan has to be executed.

TaxEfficientProduct.name: Tax Efficient Product
TaxEfficientProduct.definition: Characteristics of a tax efficient product.
